driver.note: auto | vx6 | vx8 | vx10 | vx12 and their -pro variants.

auto_driver_configuration.note: Attempts per driver candidate; opts into auto driver selection.

browser.note: chrome | firefox, or an object with a name and version.

os.note: windows | mac os | linux | android | ios.

country.note: ISO country code for the proxy, or ALL.

state.note: US state code; only with country=US.

locale.note: Browser language and region, such as en-US.

browser_actions.note: Scripted page steps run before capture; results stay in ExtractedDocument.extra.

network_capture.note: Filters for captured network calls; results stay in ExtractedDocument.extra.

parse.note: Boolean; parsed data stays in ExtractedDocument.extra.

parser.note: Custom parser configuration; output stays in ExtractedDocument.extra.

cookies.note: Cookies to send, as a list or a string.

body.note: Request body for POST, PUT and PATCH.

referrer_type.note: random | no-referer | same-origin | google | bing | facebook | twitter | instagram.

session.note: Session id and retry settings for a sticky browser session.

expected_status_codes.note: Status codes to treat as success.

skill.note: Capabilities the request needs; marked private in the reference.

realtime_total_timeout.note: Seconds, in the nimble-python signature, not the API reference.

file_parsing_options.note: Parses PDF and Office files into markdown; not in the nimble-python 1.6 signature, so send it as provider_options={'extra_body': {...}}.
